name: Cheating Time extends Flux Emitter when Shatter Echo is cast (#1979)
contract: Cheating Time 524945 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Cheating Time 524944, whose single effect is 173 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_REFRESH_AURA with EffectBasePoints 3999 / DieSides 1 (4000 ms), EffectMiscValue 804435 (Flux Emitter) and EffectMiscValueB 1, the additive branch of Spell::EffectAscensionRefreshAura. Spell.dbc gives 524945's record ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the extension could never fire. With a spell_proc row on the cast phase of Shatter Echo (family 28, word2 0x10, carried by 804503 and its ranks) at the record's own 100% ProcChance, casting Shatter Echo must raise Flux Emitter's remaining duration instead of letting it decay. Both spells carry CasterAuraSpell 804455 (Echo Fragment), so the resource is fixtured with set_aura before each cast; five stacks also give Flux Emitter its per-fragment duration bonus (Echo Fragment's effect 1 is SPELLMOD_DURATION, 5000 ms per stack), so its DurationIndex 28 base of 5000 ms becomes long enough to observe. The assertion is relative to a snapshot taken 1.5 s after the Flux Emitter cast: without the fix the remaining duration can only have fallen, so a positive delta discriminates and needs no randomness.
